title: Anduril footer
description: A black footer on a half-and-half grid: the wordmark on the left half; three link columns (grey all-caps labels over 18px white links) from the half-way line; at the bottom the all-caps copyright with small grey legal links on the left and a contact address on the right. Phones fold the columns into + accordion rows. Links grey out on hover.
notes: the phone accordion is native <details>, so it works without JavaScript
